name: Next Step Board
intro: This test opens the app itself, not a test copy, because the purple test-copy bar covers the form's “Add it” button. You will set up the board, add a project of your own with its next step, mark it Waiting, give it a checklist, and check that it stays put after a reload and with no internet.

steps.do: Tap “skip the tour” (the small underlined words at the bottom right of the welcome card).
steps.see: The card now asks “How do you want to start?” with two big choices.
steps.tip: A green greeting strip may show at the top for a few seconds. Tap it to close it, or just wait.

steps.do: Tap “🧪 Keep the examples to play with”.
steps.see: The card closes. A small “✨ A new look” note appears near the bottom of the screen.

steps.do: Tap “Got it ✓” on that note.
steps.see: The note closes. You see “My Next Step Board” at the top and example cards below it, starting with “👋 Start here (delete me when you’re ready)”.

steps.do: Scroll down to the bottom of the board and tap “+ Add project”.
steps.see: A form called “+ Add a project” slides up, with boxes for Project name, Emoji, One line, The next step, and Who / how long.

steps.do: In the “Project name” box, type the example below.
steps.see: The name appears in the box.

steps.do: In the box under “The next step”, type the example below.
steps.type: Call the church about the hall
steps.see: The words appear in that box. “Who / how long?” already says “Me”.

steps.do: Tap “Add it”.
steps.see: The form closes and a short note says “Project added”. A new card “📁 Margaret O'Brien's retirement party” is on the board with NEXT STEP “Call the church about the hall”. At the bottom it now says “5 projects”.

steps.do: On your new card, tap “Status ▸”.
steps.see: The label on the card changes from ACTIVE to WAITING, and a short note says “Status: waiting”. The card moves down the board, below the other active cards.

steps.do: Scroll back to the top and tap “Waiting” in the row of buttons under the title.
steps.see: Only two cards show: “📚 Example: Bookkeeping catch-up” and your “Margaret O'Brien's retirement party” card. It says “5 projects” at the bottom (that counts the whole board).

steps.do: Tap “All” to see every card again.
steps.see: All five cards are back.

steps.do: On your new card, tap “No checklist yet ▾”, then type the example in the “add an item…” box.
steps.see: The checklist opens with an empty “add an item…” box and an “Add” button; your words are in the box.

steps.do: Tap “Add” next to that box.
steps.see: A short note says “Added”. The card now says “Checklist (1 open)” with “Book the caterer — Me” and a tick box.

steps.do: Tap the tick box next to “Book the caterer”.
steps.see: The item is crossed off and a note says the checklist is CLEAR (“🏁 … checklist CLEAR”). The card says “Checklist (0 open)”.

steps.do: Pull the page down to reload it (or tap ↻ in Safari).
steps.see: The board comes back. Your “Margaret O'Brien's retirement party” card is still there, still WAITING, with “Book the caterer” ticked off. The bottom still says “5 projects”.

steps.do: Turn on Airplane Mode (swipe down from the top-right corner, tap ✈️). Then scroll to the bottom and tap “+ Add project”.
steps.see: A brown strip at the top says “No connection right now — the app still works and saves on this phone.” The “+ Add a project” form opens as before.

steps.do: Type the example in “Project name”, then tap “Add it”.
steps.see: “Project added” shows, and a new “📁 Fix the back door” card is on the board. The bottom says “6 projects”.

steps.do: Turn Airplane Mode off. Then tap “+ Add project” again and, without typing anything, tap “Add it”.
steps.see: The brown “No connection” strip goes away. Nothing is added: the form stays open and the “Project name” box is outlined, waiting for a name.

steps.do: Tap “Cancel” on the form.
steps.see: The form closes. Still “6 projects”.

steps.do: On the “Fix the back door” card, tap the red ✕ (right of “✏️ Card”). When the box asks “Delete "Fix the back door" and its checklist?”, tap OK.
steps.see: The card disappears, a note says “Deleted”, and the bottom says “5 projects”.

steps.do: Scroll to the very top and read the 👋 “Where you left off” box.
steps.see: It says “2 projects waiting” (the bookkeeping example and your party).
